visual.label: title · compiled <date> · verified <date>
visual.pattern: faceted opaque surface with continuous edge lines
visual.motion: slow axial rotation; responds only to compile or scan events
visual.tether: continuous line to every supporting source
visual.interaction: select opens compiled explanation, claims, tethers, related, supersession history
visual.reducedMotion: static faceted structure; state shown by edge continuity
visual.lowPerformance: lower facet count; edge lines and label retained

visual.label: title · path · sha256 prefix · ingestion state
visual.pattern: closed monolith or tablet with an engraved hash band; never opens, only projects
visual.motion: none of its own; a light projection may emerge when read
visual.tether: target of tethers; never a source of them
visual.interaction: select shows record, canonical path, hash, provenance, relationships; read creates a projection, never an edit

visual.label: OD id · title · date
visual.pattern: plinth plus monument with a raised golden seal glyph and a keyed collar
visual.motion: seal descends once on approval; otherwise still
visual.authorityMark: owner seal glyph (form), never colour alone
visual.tether: governed signals radiate to dependent nodes and project surfaces
visual.interaction: select shows decision, consequences, applies-to, dependents

visual.label: title · proposed <date> · by <compiler>
visual.pattern: wireframe with dashed edges and visible interior; alpha 0.35
visual.motion: gentle drift; flicker only when unsupported
visual.tether: dashed tether to what it was derived from
visual.interaction: select shows proposal, sources, required approval

visual.label: claim A ⇄ claim B · contested since <date>
visual.pattern: two half-structures with a standing interference lattice between them
visual.motion: slow phase beat between the halves
visual.tether: both halves keep their own tethers; the field links the two
visual.interaction: select shows both claims, both sources, authority classes, resolution path
visual.lowPerformance: split node retained; lattice simplified to lines

visual.label: title · superseded by <id> on <date>
visual.pattern: desaturated, lower luminance, intact geometry, a directed arrow tether to the successor
visual.motion: drifts into a historical orbit once; then still
visual.interaction: selectable; shows the evidence or decision that superseded it
visual.reducedMotion: appears in historical orbit without drift
visual.lowPerformance: retained; never culled to tidy the galaxy

visual.label: title · unverified
visual.pattern: incomplete geometry with missing facets; tether ends in a frayed stub
visual.tether: frayed stub where a source should be
visual.interaction: select shows what evidence would complete it

visual.label: value · source authority · as of <time>
visual.pattern: pulse packets along a lane; no body that could be mistaken for a structure
visual.motion: continuous while live; ends when the signal ends
visual.tether: none; it points at the authority it came from
visual.interaction: select opens the Evidence View of the live authority
visual.reducedMotion: static packet with timestamp; still no persistent body

visual.label: title · verified <signature prefix> · <date>
visual.pattern: solid structure carrying a machined signature band; band shape only appears with a signature
visual.motion: signature band engages once on verification
visual.tether: continuous tether to the check run or gate decision
visual.interaction: select shows the check, exit result, timestamp and SHA

broken.pattern: line ends in a jagged break with a fault glyph

stale.pattern: dashed with a mismatch glyph at the source end

absent.pattern: short stub from the claim, no target

invariants: among persistent classes, visualStability never exceeds that of any class with a strictly higher authorityRank (owner_approved_decision and immutable_raw_evidence are peers at rank 9); live_operational_signal is non-persistent and deliberately unstable
colourToken is never the only difference between two entries
live_operational_signal is the only non-persistent class
only deterministically_verified_fact and owner_approved_decision carry an authorityMark
superseded_claim always renders its successor tether
rendering reads epistemicClass from the graph and never assigns it
